title: reader/dispatch: remove dead AuthinfoPass/check_credentials code
description: dispatch.rs has AuthinfoPass branches at lines ~90 and ~205, and a check_credentials() helper calling verify_bcrypt_sync(). These are dead code: lifecycle.rs intercepts Command::AuthinfoPass at line 551, processes it completely, and calls continue — so dispatch() never sees AuthinfoPass in production. The verify_bcrypt_sync() function and check_credentials() helper, plus the AuthinfoPass match arms in dispatch(), should be removed. Also remove the DUMMY_HASH OnceLock from credentials.rs once verify_bcrypt_sync() is gone.
